name: PT Tri Banyan Tirta Tbk
summary: PT Tri Banyan Tirta Tbk manufactures and sells bottled mineral and flavored water under the Alto and Total brand names in Indonesia. It also sells alkaline water products under the Total 8+ brand. In addition, the company operates as an original equipment manufacturer for bottled VIT products. It serves plastic packaging, food, beverages, and canning/bottling industries, as well as packaging materials sector. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Sukabumi, Indonesia. PT Tri Banyan Tirta Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Fikasa Bintang Cemerlang.
